description: This file defines the class 'pPie' responsible for drawing various types of pie and ring charts, including 2D, 3D, and their variants, using a chart object and data object. It contains methods for rendering charts, setting slice colors, and handling label positions, along with several constants and private utility functions.

classes.name: pPie
classes.description: Class to draw pie, ring, and their 3D variants with customization options for labels, colors, and effects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize with chart and data objects.

methods.name: draw2DPie
methods.description: Draws a 2D pie chart with specified parameters.

methods.name: draw3DPie
methods.description: Draws a 3D pie chart with specified parameters.

methods.name: drawPieLegend
methods.description: Draws the legend for the pie chart.

methods.name: setSliceColor
methods.description: Sets the color for a specific slice in the chart.

methods.name: writePieLabel
methods.description: Computes label positions for pie slices and draws arrow labels.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Adjusts label positions internally to avoid overlaps.

methods.name: writeShiftedLabels
methods.description: Draws labels after internal position adjustments.

methods.name: arraySerialize
methods.description: Serializes an array of points into a string representation.

methods.name: clean0Values
methods.description: Removes unused data series and null values from the dataset, updating the palette accordingly.
